title: Why Do the Cowboys Wear White at Home?
topic: Since the 1960s GM Tex Schramm had Dallas wear white at home so fans saw every opponent's colours (and, per Gil Brandt, so visitors sweated in dark jerseys); blue later got a 'curse' after big losses.
